verdict.rationale: AI-generated recaps are a fair capability to expect from a chat and community platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Discord producing AI summaries or recaps of channels or threads. The evidence covers threads themselves, bots, the API and Gateway events, but these are only developer building blocks for constructing such a feature, not the feature itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed
